subject: Acme Health — evaluation scope & multi-region perf tests
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-11T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up: evaluation scope & next tests

Hi Sanjay / Marta —

Thanks again for the discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of needs you shared:
- Low-latency inference for clinical summarization (P95 < 350ms preferred for short prompts in EU)
- Data residency in the EU for certain PHI-adjacent flows, APAC presence for pilot region
- Comparison vs existing endpoints (BigCloud AI + InferNow) for latency, cost per token, and tail stability
- SOC 2 & audit artifacts for procurement

Proposed next steps (action items):
1) Run baseline latency tests from EU, US East, and APAC (our hosted endpoints + BigCloud + InferNow). We’ll provide test harness + results CSV.
2) Confirm data residency routing requirements (which endpoints must remain in EU) — Sanjay to confirm list of flows.
3) Share SOC 2 and runtime security doc (Marcus will attach).
4) Schedule a 60-minute test setup call to walk through the harness and networking.

Please confirm the following by EOD Thursday so we can seed the tests:
- Which two production flows you want in the EU-only bucket (examples: clinical-summarize, triage-classifier)
- Whether you want sampling at 10 TPS or 50 TPS for the baseline run

I’ve attached an evaluation matrix (acme-eval-matrix.xlsx) and a quick CSV of region probes we’ll use (redwood-region-latency.csv). We can adjust the matrix if you have additional KPIs.

Thanks —
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: acme-eval-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)
Attachments: redwood-region-latency.csv (CSV, region probe seeds)
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: evaluation scope & next tests

Jordan —

Appreciate the quick recap. A few clarifications from our side:
- EU-only flows (must not leave EU): clinical-summarize, patient-qa (these are the priority).
- Baseline sampling: start at 10 TPS, then spike to 50 TPS for a stress window. We’ll want P50/P95/P99 for each region.
- APAC: our team in Singapore would like an APAC probe; please include SG regions (we expect higher latency but want the comparative curve).
- SOC 2: procurement needs SOC 2 Type II plus evidence of retention and access logs. Please attach the certificate and a short artifact list.

I’ll loop in procurement once we have an initial test plan.

Also, can you include a simple cost estimate — rough $/1000 tokens for both hosted and dedicated for the baseline models you propose? That helps us prioritize.

Thanks,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Platform Engineering | Acme Health
Sanjay.Rao@acmehealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-12T11:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: evaluation scope & next tests

Thanks — that’s super helpful.

I’ve attached a proposed test plan (redwood-test-plan.md) with step-by-step harness instructions, metric definitions (P50/P95/P99, tail-Jitter), and a simple cost matrix for hosted vs dedicated for the two model sizes we discussed (medium & large). High level cost pointers (preliminary):
- Hosted (on-demand): $1.60 / 1k tokens (medium), $3.40 / 1k tokens (large) — includes cross-region routing premium
- Dedicated (reserved): equivalent unit economics can fall ~20–35% depending on commit and region (we’ll provide firm numbers once you pick model variant and target throughput)

We can also run a short canary in the EU private control plane if you prefer strict residency for the two flows — that requires a short setup window and a minimal dedicated pool.

Proposed times for the 60-min setup call: Tue 2025-11-18 09:00 or Wed 2025-11-19 14:00 (PST). Which works for you?

I’ll also bring Laura (solutions lead) to walkthrough the harness.

Jordan

Attachments: redwood-test-plan.md (text)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-13T08:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: evaluation scope & next tests

Hi all — quick technical addendum from the SE side.

A few notes to ensure tests are apples-to-apples vs BigCloud AI and InferNow: 
- Model variants: use same sequence length (max 512) and identical tokenization jars; we’ll provide a containerized harness to ensure parity.
- Routing: Redwood will pin EU-only flows to EU regions and will not egress tokens; our private control plane + VPC option keeps KV cache and request logs within customer VPC if needed.
- Caching effects: to measure cold vs warm latency, we’ll run 2 warmup passes and then a 30k-request window per region.

Preliminary, non-production numbers (internal benchmark excerpt):
- Redwood hosted (eu-west): P95 310ms (medium model), cost est $1.55/1k
- BigCloud AI endpoint (eu-west): P95 420ms (same model), cost est $1.80/1k
- InferNow (eu-west): P95 360ms, cost est $1.65/1k

We’ll keep these internal numbers labeled as preliminary until we run your exact workload. For the APAC probes, expect ~50–120ms added latency depending on regional egress paths — we’ll surface traceroutes as part of the harness.

Dashboard and instrumentation: I’ll share a Prometheus + Grafana read-only dashboard after the harness runs (sample link below).

–Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Related sample dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/probe-dashboard
From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Follow-up: evaluation scope & next tests

Jordan / Marcus —

Thanks — this looks actionable. A few procurement/network asks before the setup call:
- Please share SOC 2 Type II cert and 12-month evidence list (retention, access logs, incident history summary).
- Network egress guidance: what egress ranges and ports will we see from your hosted endpoints? Any expected outbound to BigCloud (for fallbacks) or is that entirely under our control?
- Rough estimate of egress bandwidth costs for a 30k-request run (we are trying to budget spot charges).

We’d like to schedule the 60-min call on Tue 2025-11-18 09:00 PST. Also, please send an NDA/DocuSign so procurement can process. I attached the procurement contact PDF.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Senior Product Manager | Acme Health
Marta.Lopez@acmehealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acmehealth.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@acmehealth.com>

Date: 2025-11-18T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: evaluation scope & next tests — confirmed call + pre-call checklist

Great — confirmed for Tue 2025-11-18 09:00 PST (I sent the calendar invite). Agenda and pre-call checklist below so we make the most of the 60 minutes: 

Agenda (60m):
- 10m: Introductions + goals (Sanjay/Marta)
- 20m: Walkthrough of the containerized test harness (Laura)
- 15m: Network / security Q&A (Marcus)
- 10m: Next steps: timeline for dedicated pool/Canary (Jordan)
- 5m: Close and action item review

Pre-call checklist for Acme (please complete if possible so we can start right away):
- Confirm the two EU-only flows: clinical-summarize, patient-qa (you already confirmed — thanks)
- Provide a sample payload (or 3 sample payloads) to place into harness (upload to the Drive folder linked below)
- Procurement: review attached NDA link and confirm signer info for DocuSign

Quick answers to Marta’s asks: 
- SOC 2: certificate and 12-month artifact list uploaded to the DocuSign room and Drive link we shared.
- Egress ranges/ports: we will use standard HTTPS egress; IP ranges are in the shared doc (will post to Drive tonight).
- Egress estimate: for a 30k-request run (avg 1.2KB payload + 2.0KB response) expect ~100MB outbound — egress billing varies by cloud region but should be under $10 for the test window in most regions.

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/12345 (deal RDW-ACME-2025-07). I’ll follow up after the call with the first-pass results and a recommendation for hosted vs dedicated for your pilot.

See you Tuesday —
Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachments: (NDA link posted to Drive)
